messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.

ASSAY TYPE: Digital Microfluidic Bead Densification and Processing Coupled to Single-Molecule Array (DMF-Simoa) for Tumor Necrosis Factor-alpha (TNF-alpha) Quantification

REAGENTS USED:
  - TNF-alpha Sample (solution of TNF-alpha antigen, 100 uL aliquot)
  - Simoa Capture Beads (anti-TNF-alpha antibody-coated superparamagnetic beads, 25 uL suspension containing 15000 functionalized beads)
  - Biotinylated Detection Antibody (anti-TNF-alpha detection antibody, 20 uL aliquot)
  - Wash Buffer (PBS containing 0.01% w/v Tetronic 90R4 surfactant)
  - Streptavidin-beta-Galactosidase (SbG) Reagent (enzyme label conjugate)
  - RGP Substrate (resorufin-beta-D-galactopyranoside fluorogenic substrate)

STEPS:
1. Off-chip pre-incubation: Mix the 100 uL TNF-alpha sample, 25 uL bead suspension (15000 beads), and 20 uL detection antibody together; incubate for 20 min off-chip on a shaker at 800 rpm to form antibody-antigen-bead sandwich immunocomplexes.
2. Stepwise sample loading onto DMF: Dispense the entire pre-incubated sample-bead mixture onto the sample reservoir electrode; sequentially load, split, and remove waste from ~9 uL segments over ~12 closed-loop, capacitance-monitored cycles to fully transfer the sample into the device while retaining beads on the densifying electrode (>98% bead retention).
3. Bead washing: Wash the densified beads with fresh wash buffer over multiple wash cycles (5 repeats) to remove unbound sample components.
4. SbG incubation: Deliver the streptavidin-beta-galactosidase reagent to the densified beads and incubate for 5 min at 25C to label captured immunocomplexes with enzyme.
5. Post-SbG washing: Wash the labeled beads again with fresh wash buffer over multiple wash cycles (5 repeats) to remove excess unbound SbG.
6. Substrate addition and detection: Deliver the RGP (resorufin-beta-D-galactopyranoside) substrate to the washed, labeled beads and incubate for 30 min at 25C to allow enzymatic conversion to fluorescent resorufin; the processed bead suspension is then collected and transferred to a microtiter plate/SR-X imager, where beads are loaded into femtoliter-sized microwells and imaged to determine the average number of enzyme labels per bead (digital single-molecule readout), then the analyzed droplet is discarded.

INTERPRETATION: Successful DMF-Simoa TNF-alpha quantification is confirmed by calibration curves of average enzyme labels per bead vs. TNF-alpha concentration obtained via the DMF-processed workflow that are comparable to those obtained via conventional manual microtiter-plate Simoa processing, with more than 98% bead retention during stepwise sample loading and no significant loss of assay sensitivity, supporting the feasibility of a miniaturized, automated DMF-Simoa platform for ultrasensitive biomarker detection.

module fluorescence

manifest tnf_sample
manifest simoa_beads
manifest detection_antibody
manifest wash_buffer
manifest sbg_reagent
manifest rgp_substrate

instructions:

sample = dispense 100 units of tnf_sample
beads = dispense 25 units of simoa_beads
dab = dispense 20 units of detection_antibody

a = mix sample with beads
b = mix a with dab for 60s
heat b at 23c for 20m
dispose b

repeat 12 times {
    sample2 = dispense 9 units of tnf_sample
    beads2 = dispense 25 units of simoa_beads
    c = mix sample2 with beads2 for 5s
    dispose c
}

repeat 5 times {
    wash = dispense 250 units of wash_buffer
    beads3 = dispense 25 units of simoa_beads
    d = mix wash with beads3 for 45s
    dispose d
}

sbg = dispense 20 units of sbg_reagent
beads4 = dispense 25 units of simoa_beads
e = mix beads4 with sbg for 60s
heat e at 25c for 5m

repeat 5 times {
    wash2 = dispense 250 units of wash_buffer
    beads5 = dispense 25 units of simoa_beads
    f = mix wash2 with beads5 for 45s
    dispose f
}

rgp = dispense 50 units of rgp_substrate
beads6 = dispense 25 units of simoa_beads
g = mix beads6 with rgp
heat g at 25c for 30m

tnf_reading = detect fluorescence on g for 5m
dispose g

metadata.notes: The authored BioScript code is a direct translation of the paper's TNF-alpha Simoa bead-processing workflow (Experimental Section, 'Simoa bead processing', and Fig. 5a), covering the off-chip sample/bead/detection-antibody pre-incubation, the stepwise DMF sample loading of the 100 uL sample onto the bead-densifying electrode (Fig. 3, ~12 cycles), the bead wash cycles, the SbG labeling incubation, a second wash series, and the final RGP substrate incubation and detection step. Because BioScript's grammar requires every 'dispense' statement to draw from a manifest-declared source reagent (never from an intermediate 'mix' result), and has no primitive for a single physical bead pellet that is repeatedly washed/retained/moved across a stationary densifying electrode over many sequential operations, the 'simoa_beads' manifest is re-dispensed before each wash/incubation step rather than a single bead-droplet handle being reused and washed in place -- consistent with how the enzyme reagent is re-dispensed across wash loops in the ciprofloxacin reference protocol. Likewise, because the paper's actual readout is offline imaging on a Quanterix SR-X imager (counting individual enzyme-labeled beads in femtoliter microwells to obtain an average-enzyme-labels-per-bead digital signal), not a bulk fluorogenic plate read, the 'detect fluorescence' primitive is used only as a stand-in for this generic detect-and-quantify step, since BioScript's grammar does not expose a dedicated single-molecule-array/digital-imaging detect module.

numeric_mismatches.note: The paper's densified bead population is a single physical pellet retained on the densifying electrode and washed/incubated in place across many sequential steps; BioScript has no persistent-droplet primitive for this, so the beads are modeled as a fresh 'dispense simoa_beads' before each wash/incubation step rather than one droplet handle carried through the whole workflow.

Detection in the paper is performed by transferring the processed beads to a Quanterix SR-X imager, which images beads sealed individually in femtoliter microwells to compute an average number of enzyme labels per bead (a digital, Poisson-statistics-based readout), not a bulk fluorescence intensity measurement. 'detect fluorescence' is used only because it is the sole detect module exposed by BioScript's grammar.

numeric_mismatches.field: heat e at 25c for 5m (SbG incubation) and heat g at 25c for 30m (RGP incubation)
numeric_mismatches.note: The paper does not state explicit on-chip SbG or RGP incubation durations for the DMF workflow itself (these steps are described only as being 'conducted on a design-1 DMF device' and cross-referenced to the standard microtiter-plate protocol in ref. 3); the 5 min and 30 min durations used here are reasonable estimated processing times adapted for BioScript's required heat-duration syntax, not values quoted directly from this paper.

numeric_mismatches.field: wash cycle volumes (250 units) and durations (45s) in the two 5x wash-loop blocks
numeric_mismatches.note: The paper states that washing steps occurred on the DMF device but does not give an exact per-cycle wash volume/duration for the TNF-alpha bead-washing steps specifically; the 250-unit/45s pattern is adapted from the analogous passive-loading wash-chamber convention used elsewhere in this test suite, not a value taken directly from the Simoa bead processing section.

numeric_mismatches.field: capacitance-based closed-loop control of the 12-cycle stepwise loading (Fig. 3b/c)
numeric_mismatches.note: Not modeled. BioScript has no primitive for real-time capacitance feedback, sub-step timing control, or the open-loop vs. closed-loop distinction described in the paper; the loop is represented only as 12 uniform load/mix/dispose cycles.

numeric_mismatches.field: bead-densifying electrode geometry/model (Fig. 4, Note S1), parallel/passive loading alternatives (Fig. 1 and 2), and the SR-X microtiter-plate control comparison
numeric_mismatches.note: Not modeled. These are device-design characterization experiments, alternative loading strategies not used in the final assay, or head-to-head validation/comparison sub-experiments run alongside the core assay, and fall outside the scope of this translation; only the core Simoa bead-processing workflow (Fig. 5a) is captured here.
